liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): The China Cat into Rider transition is described as perfectly electric; The China Cat into Rider is called a standout of the show [8][10]
- **Touch of Grey** (1 review): Among the earliest performances of this then-new song [7]
- **Far From Me** (1 review): Brent's playing on this version is singled out as outstanding [8]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Listener who attended hears it as one of the hottest Estimated/Eyes pairings ever [15]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Heard as exceptionally hot, paired with Estimated Prophet, by a listener who was there [15]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Reviewer notes this song was still new at the time [7]

## The recordings

- **gd82-12-26.sbd.clugston.6665.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 142 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Rated as high-quality, classic soundboard sound; Reviewer finds the soundboard tinny with low levels, weaker than many other archive shows; Tinny; drumstick hits are clear but the other instruments sound somewhat muddled [7][8][9]
- **gd1982-12-26.154593.senn-md441u.liff.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 145 min [3]. Said about its sound: The mix during this song is very messy [3]
- **gd1982-12-26.sbd.lai.1420.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 137 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Decent soundboard recording that captures the tight 1982 band sound [14]
- **gd1982-12-26.set2.sbd.miller.95953.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 82 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recorded sound and its cleanup are exceptionally good for this show [16]

## Around the show

- Reportedly Phil Lesh's first show playing a six-string Alembic bass [14]
- Reviewer believes Phil first used his new six-string Modulus bass at this show [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd82-12-26.sbd.clugston.6665.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > CDR [1]. Also: Master soundboard cassette transferred to CDR, mastered and shortened to SHN by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1982-12-26.154593.senn-md441u.liff.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Dan Liff; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: (FOB) Senn MD441-U > Sony TC-D5 > Cassette Master (Maxell UDXLII C90 Dolby On) > Nakamichi 581 > Cassette (1st gen) [3]. Also: Tape paused between songs; those gaps were smoothed with crossfades. Doug Lamarre supplied the source, Matt Vernon transferred it; The start of Space was patched using a source from Michael Kirschner and Charlie Miller [3]
- **gd1982-12-26.sbd.lai.1420.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai and Bruce Fried; source: SDB>>MR>>PCM>>DAT>>CDR there may be a cassette gen somewhere in the lineage, but i am not positive. [5]
- **gd1982-12-26.set2.sbd.miller.95953.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> PCM [6]
